title: Affine-local canonical truncation comparison for higher direct image
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], $q\in\mathbf Z$, and let $U\subseteq Y$ be an affine open. For some $n\in\mathbf Z$, the restriction to $U$ of the canonical map $H^q(Rf_*E)\to H^q(Rf_*\tau_{\geq -n}E)$ is an isomorphism. Here $Rf_*$ is [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and the truncation and its projection are [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. No quasi-coherence assertion about either side is included.

proof.text: Put $V=f^{-1}(U)$ and consider $f_U:V\to U$. This is qcqs by stability under base change along an open immersion, and the affine scheme $U$ is quasi-compact. Restriction is exact and preserves quasi-coherence, so $E|_V$ has quasi-coherent cohomology. Use the standard localization model for the two local derived categories; the choices do not alter the comparison because all functors come from localization.

Use [lem-pc-restrict-derived-direct-image-open] to obtain the natural identification $(Rf_*E)|_U\cong R(f_U)_*(E|_V)$. This is computed by restricting a K-injective resolution, using [lem-sc-derived-k-injective-restrict-open]. The comparison is natural in the morphism $E\to\tau_{\geq -n}E$.

Apply the second clause of [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-uniform-truncation-bound] to $f_U$, $E|_V$, and $q$. Choose its threshold $n_0$ as $n$. The q-th higher direct image of the canonical truncation projection on $V$ is an isomorphism.

Exact restriction commutes with homology and canonical truncation, including its projection: use Functor.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso and Functor.mapDerivedCategoryTruncGEIso from the existing exact-functor library. These comparisons carry the isomorphism from the previous step to the restriction to $U$ of the q-th higher direct image of the global projection. Naturality of the open-restriction comparison identifies this with the displayed map.

Restriction to an affine open of the derived direct image canonical truncation map is an isomorphism in any fixed cohomology degree for sufficiently low truncation

theorem exists_isIso_schemeHigherDirectImage_truncGE_over_affine
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X E)
    (q : ℤ) (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    ∃ n : ℤ, IsIso
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace) U.1).map
        ((schemeHigherDirectImage f q).map
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGEπ (-n)).app E)))
